basis: Asked by the agent on 24 November 2026 how Bro Hof should reach main, the owner chose "Owner acceptance": a dated record that admits Bro Hof as advisory like the other ten grounds, names what is not proven, keeps the structure and file checks, and leaves the full review required for any other new ground. On 27 November 2026 the owner asked for tree round r1b ("Do the next tree round now"), which produced generation a78474a4 (it differs from 30268b63 only in its tree records: the eight flagpoles, a lamp post and a pole decided not-tree, one car-park tree placed). Asked whether to re-record this acceptance for the new generation, he answered "Re-record it and merge (Recommended)". The open items are unchanged.

open.canonical-control-pending: No independent horizontal or RH 2000 ground control has been measured at Bro Hof. The frame is the 1 m national terrain and the 0.16 m orthophoto, which agree with each other.
open.canonical-frame: The ground's origin is fixed in software and has not been approved against independent control, as at every other ground.
open.release-review: The 14-gate release review does not exist: no phone timings, no per-hole review by a person, no offline or rollback rehearsal on this candidate.
open.surface-intake-pending: All 36 holes were traced on the 2025 orthophoto and looked through hole by hole by the agent on 24 November (paired overlays); the owner has not reviewed the outlines.
